source.game: Dune — The Battle for Arrakis, Sega Genesis USA

pixelPolicy: Original 4bpp patterns, native mappings/flips and CRAM colors. No interpolation, recoloring, redrawing or generated art.

iconPalette.alpha: Nibble 0 transparent, as in the native SAT sprite renderer

animation.note: The native building monitor resource is one image. Console flashes, digits and chrome animations are separate menu effects, not additional building image frames.

illustration.nativeLengthQuirk: Original Refinery record declares 2700 upload bytes, while its complete LCW stream contains 2720. This PNG preserves the complete decoded ROM resource; the native upload may retain 20 prior VRAM bytes at the last tile.
